title: The Flying Wooden Horse
logline: At a king's festival of inventors a stranger's black wooden horse really flies; Prince Firuz jumps on without learning the controls, is carried above the clouds, and at sunset finds a hidden lever that may bring him down.
moral: Learn how to come down before you go up: eagerness without patience carries you further than you meant.
tone: Bright storybook adventure in 80s cel anime: a sunny, crowded festival with gentle comedy, then a sudden wide, lonely sky; wonder first, then suspense, ending on a warm sunset cliffhanger.

beats.summary: A king holds a festival for inventors in his palace garden.
A stranger wheels in a black wooden horse fitted with brass.
The guests laugh at the horse that does nothing; a dove perches on it.
The stranger claims it flies faster than the wind; the king demands proof.
One turn of the neck knob and the wood rises and circles the garden.
Prince Firuz comes forward and fixes on the knob.
The inventor points to the second control near the ear; the prince is not looking.
The horse shoots up like an arrow; the palace shrinks to a toy.
He calls and nothing answers: alone in the sky.
Turning the knob back only makes the horse climb.
Cold, above the clouds, he searches the horse for a sign.
He remembers the inventor pointing near the ear.
Under the carved mane he finds a small lever.
He reaches for it as the sun sets: the cliffhanger.

sets.description: The king's palace garden court (planned name palaceGarden, cel plate variant 'kingFestival'). Strip 2000 wide, ground y 900, sky plate from y -820 to 1230 so the camera can go as wide as zoom 0.62. Left to right: garden wall with the gate arch (opening x 60..220, top y 560); lawn with rose hedge along the back (hedge top y 770), two cypresses at x 330 and 720 (tops y 430), fountain at x 520 (basin 200 wide, rim y 860, jet to y 700); paved court x 800..1300 with an eight-point star in the tiles centred x 1020 (the horse's spot); inventors' tables at x 1340..1440 (top y 800: brass mechanical bird, armillary sphere, toy windmill); royal dais x 1540..1940 (top y 840, three steps on its left x 1480..1540), throne at x 1760 (seat y 792, sitY for person sit), striped canopy on four poles (top y 430). Behind, from x 700 to 2000: the palace: cream walls #f6ead0 (shade #d9c3a8), lower arcade of six pointed arches (each 130 wide, base y 760, top y 460) trimmed coral #e8604a, upper storey to y 250 with small windows, central turquoise dome (centre x 1350, base y 250, r 170, gold finial to y 0), two smaller domes (x 1000 and 1700, r 90), two minarets (x 800 and 1900, tops y -120). Far layer: city roofs, palms and soft hills. Live parts: bunting lines from the minarets to the cypresses (emerald, gold, coral, white flags as ribbons), eight lanterns, emerald banners with a gold sun, fountain jet, clouds, two kites, the sun at (300, -200).

The flight world for the whole series: a 1000 x 1230 frame with no ground. Painted sky plates by altitude and time (fields alt 0..1, u time of day), three cloud layers (far 0.2, mid 0.5, near 1.0 parallax; near clouds may pass in front of the horse) scrolled by vx and vy, an optional cloud deck (deck: true, tops at y 760..900) that takes the horse's shadow, a sun disc, and the land plate kingdomBelow (patchwork fields, a river, roads, towns; variant 'home' has the palace on its centre line as palaceToy, scaled by k 1.0..0.14 about (500, 1000); variant 'far' is unknown country). Plates used here: day low (azure #3a8ef0 to #bfe6ff, white cumulus), day high (cobalt #2a5ad0 above, pale #d8f0ff horizon, thin cirrus), golden hour (blue #5a8ae0 above, cream-gold horizon #ffe2a0, clouds white with apricot undersides), sunset (blue-violet #5a6ad0 above, pink #ff9ab0, coral #ff8a5a and gold #ffd27a at the horizon, peach cloud undersides, two stars).

props.description: platformCart (the planned handcart in a 'platform' variant): a low wooden trolley 300 long x 34 thick, top 58 above the ground, four small spoked wheels r 24 (two visible), a T push bar at the rear 150 high, leaf springs under the platform so it sags 6 under the horse and springs back 8 when the horse leaves; painted red-brown #a8552a with brass corner caps.

The ascent knob (part of ebonyHorse): brass disc r 14 at s 1 with a pointer notch on a round plate r 22 engraved with an up arrow, on the near side at the base of the neck, horse-local about (88, -205). Field knob = angle in radians.

The descent lever (part of ebonyHorse): brass lever 38 long with a ball tip r 5 on a small plate engraved with a down arrow, hidden under the overhang of the first mane block just behind the ear, horse-local about (126, -292). Hidden in every wide shot (the mane block is drawn over it); field reveal 0..1 lights it; field lever = angle.

subtitles.ar: أقام ملك احتفالًا في قصره ودعا المخترعين.|جاء رجل غريب على عربة صغيرة يدفع أمامه حصانًا أسود من الخشب، تزينه قطع نحاسية لامعة.
subtitles.en: A king held a palace celebration and invited inventors.|A stranger arrived with a small cart, pushing a black wooden horse decorated with shining brass fittings.

subtitles.ar: ضحك بعض الحاضرين حين رأوا الحصان الساكن، لكن الرجل قال: «هذا ليس للزينة؛|يستطيع أن يطير أسرع من الريح».|طلب الملك منه أن يثبت كلامه أمام الجميع.
subtitles.en: Some guests laughed at the motionless horse, but the man said, “This is no ornament;|it can fly faster than the wind.”|The king asked him to prove his claim before everyone.

subtitles.ar: أدار المخترع مقبضًا صغيرًا عند رقبة الحصان، فارتفع الخشب عن الأرض،|وحلق فوق الحديقة قبل أن يعود.|صفق الناس بدهشة، واقترب الأمير فيروز ليفحص الحصان بنفسه.
subtitles.en: The inventor turned a small knob beside the horse’s neck. The wooden figure rose from the ground,|flew over the garden, and returned.|The crowd applauded, and Prince Firuz came closer to inspect it.

subtitles.ar: قال فيروز: «دعني أجربه».|حذره المخترع أن يتعلم مقبضي الصعود والهبوط أولًا،|لكن الأمير جلس سريعًا وأدار المقبض الذي رآه.
subtitles.en: “Let me try it,” said Firuz.|The inventor warned him to learn the ascent and descent controls first,|but the prince quickly mounted and turned the knob he had seen.

subtitles.ar: اندفع الحصان إلى أعلى كالسهم،|وصغر القصر تحته حتى صار مثل لعبة صغيرة.|نادى الأمير من السماء، لكنه لم يسمع جوابًا، ولم يعرف كيف يعود إلى الأرض.
subtitles.en: The horse shot upward like an arrow,|and the palace shrank beneath him until it looked like a toy.|The prince called from the sky but heard no answer and did not know how to descend.

subtitles.ar: حاول فيروز إدارة المقبض في الاتجاه الآخر، فارتفع الحصان أكثر.|رأى الغيوم تمر تحت قدميه،|وشعر بالبرد، وأخذ يبحث عن علامة تدله على طريقة الهبوط.
subtitles.en: Firuz tried turning the knob the other way, but the horse rose higher.|He watched clouds pass beneath his feet,|felt the cold, and searched for a sign of how to descend.

subtitles.ar: تذكر أن المخترع أشار إلى شيء قرب الأذن.|انحنى وفحص رأس الحصان، فرأى ذراعًا صغيرة تحت عرفه الخشبي.
subtitles.en: He remembered the inventor pointing near the ear.|Leaning forward, Firuz inspected the horse’s head and found a small lever beneath its carved mane.

subtitles.ar: نظر فيروز إلى الأرض والذراع،|وقال: «لعلها طريق النجاة». مد يده إليها مع غروب الشمس.
subtitles.en: Firuz looked at the earth and the lever.|“Perhaps this is my way to safety,” he said, reaching for it as the sun set.

new_assets.name: ebonyHorse
new_assets.description: The series' wooden flying horse. Same size and seat as the Library horse (320 wide, back 235, head top 335 at s 1) but plainly carved: body a long barrel 230 x 105 with two plank seams; four straight legs like a carousel horse (slightly splayed, no knees bending) with brass discs r 11 at shoulder, hip and each knee; brass hooves; neck a thick arched block ending in a wedge head with a squared muzzle; a brass disc eye r 7 with no pupil; upright carved ears; mane as seven stepped rectangular blocks (each about 24 x 20, chisel lines, brass edge strip) down the crest; tail a single carved S-curl 120 long that never swings; a built-in saddle 110 long with a low pommel on a painted crimson-and-gold saddle cloth (long enough for two riders in episodes 3 to 5); brass chest plate with a sun boss, brass bridle studs. Colours: ebony #3a3448 (lifted so the legs read), shade #241f30, far legs #2c2738, highlight edge #6a6288, brass #e0b038 (shade #a87a1c, hi #fff1b0), cloth #e8264f with #f2c040 border. Controls: knob and lever (see props).
new_assets.implementation: ebonyHorse(ctx, P) with P {x, y, s, dir, rot, knob, lever, reveal, glow} drawn with celShade polygons and ell() discs in horse-local units (feet at 0, 0; seat at EQUINE.horse.seat [-8, -238] so rideOn(ctx, ebonyHorse, P, personP, {name: 'horse', reins: false}) seats a rider); outlines are dark versions of each fill. Returns anchors {knob, lever, ear, mane[7], chest, seat, hooves[4]} in world units. powerOn(t0, rate) is a list of two-frame brass flashes in the order neck plate, chest, joints, hooves. The same function at s 4 to 4.5 is the close insert, so draw the knob plate, lever plate and mane blocks with their engraved detail.

new_assets.name: palaceGarden
new_assets.description: King's palace garden court strip 2000 wide with gate, fountain, court, inventors' tables, dais and throne, palace facade with turquoise domes and minarets, tall sky (see sets). Returns anchors {gate, fountain, court, tables, dais, throne {x, sitY}, dome}. Used again in episodes 3 and 5.
new_assets.implementation: Baked plates as in ALI-01-ANIME ab_sets.js: sky (gradient, soft clouds), far city (blurred shapes), palace facade (celShade walls, domes with a hard shade crescent and a highlight), garden and court with dressing (stones, flowers, tiles), then live cels on top: bunting and banners as sine ribbons, fountain jet (3 drawings), lanterns, kites, gadgets. A front pass redraws the rose hedge corner and one lantern string for depth.

new_assets.name: skyFlight
new_assets.description: Flight world: altitude and time-of-day sky plates, three scrolling cloud layers, cloud deck with shadow, sun, land plate kingdomBelow with the shrinking palaceToy, wind ribbons and vertical or horizontal speed lines (see sets and the series bible).
new_assets.implementation: skyFlight(ctx, t, {alt, u, vx, vy, deck, sun: [x, y, r], land: {variant, k, y}}) and skyFlightFront(ctx, t, o) for near clouds. Plates are gradients baked per (alt, u) pair and cross-faded; clouds are baked soft sprites (blurred ellipses with a lit top and a tinted underside) tiled by K.rng and wrapped modulo the layer size so any vx, vy is a pure function of t. palaceToy is the facade function at low detail baked once and drawn scaled. windRibbon(ctx, pts, t) is a pair of tapering gold strokes on a travelling sine.

new_assets.name: flyRig
new_assets.description: Flight carrier for the horse and its rider(s): position, pitch (nose up or down), a small bank, bob, and the 4-drawing turn; plus firuzCape, the crimson ribbon cape.
new_assets.implementation: flyRig(ctx, x, y, {pitch, s, dir, flip}, draw): translate to the horse's body centre (x, y - 150 s), rotate by pitch, scale x by the turn step, then draw the level horse and rider with rideOn inside it, so the seat stays true at any pitch. Because the context is rotated, give the rider body-local hand targets (handL, handR) or rig-local points, not world points. Bob = idleSway(tc, seed, 6, 2.6); pitch through flow keys; the rider's lean answers pitch changes with lagged(). firuzCape(ctx, shoulder, t, {dir, speed, hang}): 5-point ribbon, crimson #e8264f with shade #b0183a, hanging with a slow sway on the ground and streaming opposite to travel in flight (4-drawing cycle, as abCloak in ALI-01-ANIME).

new_assets.name: platformCart
new_assets.description: Low four-wheeled trolley with a push bar and leaf springs (variant of the planned handcart).
new_assets.implementation: celShade rectangles for platform and bar, wheels as ell() discs with 6 spokes rotated by x / r, a sag field moving the platform against the axles.

new_assets.name: handInsert
new_assets.description: A large hand for close inserts (turning the knob, hovering by the lever): palm 60 x 46, thumb capsule, four-finger block with three lines, sleeve cuff in the owner's colour; grip and point states.
new_assets.implementation: handInsert(ctx, x, y, {rot, s, grip, point, sleeve}) from five celShade shapes in the theme skin colour with its shade tone; posed on twos.

owner_questions: The film ends on the chrome title TO BE CONTINUED... instead of THE END, because this is episode 1 of 5 and the script stops on a cliffhanger (default: TO BE CONTINUED...).

The script does not say whether anyone rides during the first demonstration; the inventor sits on the horse for it, so that the prince can see which knob he turns and the horse has a reason to come back (default: inventor rides).
The inventor arrives pushing a low cart with the horse standing on it (the Arabic has both the cart and the pushing); default: horse on the cart, inventor walking behind.

Speech bubbles are English versions of the quoted lines; the inventor's reported warning is shown as an invented bubble LEARN UP AND DOWN FIRST! and Firuz calls HELLOOO! from the sky (default: keep both).

Added business that is not in the script: a child knocking on the horse and pulling its tail, a dove perching on the motionless horse, a hawk passing in the sky, comic failed searches (saddle pommel, knocking on the head). Default: keep, all short.
A tape transition HOURS LATER... at 107.9 moves the sky from day to late afternoon so that the sunset in the last paragraph is earned (default: keep).

Series colours set here for all five episodes: Firuz cream tunic with a crimson cape and sash, the inventor violet robe with a saffron turban (its cloth is the clue in episode 3), the king emerald; the princess is reserved turquoise with a rose sash (default: as listed in the series bible).
The title card is English only (THE FLYING WOODEN HORSE) because no Arabic title was supplied; an Arabic title line in Lalezar can be added if the owner provides the wording.
implementation_notes: Style cel-anime-80s: read Library/styles/cel-anime-80s/look.md (owner direction section first) and follow ALI-01-ANIME v4 (src/ab_kit.js, ab_sets.js, ab_cast.js, ab_main.js) for baked plates, abSay-style balloons, on-twos helpers and dressing. No colour-model tint on the cast; no dark shade pass; each time of day is a repainted plate.
Characters on twos: pose every cast channel at tc = celStep(t, THEME.celFps); blinks and lip flaps at celStep(t, 8). Camera, plates, cloud scroll, light bands, glints and the CRT pass use t.

The ebony horse is the one deliberately lifeless thing on screen: no blink, breath, ear or tail motion, legs never move. Its life is light (glints, bands, powerOn) and the rig (bob, pitch). Everything else on screen keeps a moving hold.

Riders: rideOn(ctx, ebonyHorse, P, personP, {name: 'horse', reins: false}) inside flyRig. Check on a still that the hips sit on the saddle and that the hand reaches the knob anchor (about horse-local 88, -205) and, with lurch about 0.4, the mane block by the ear; shorten the neck up to 10 percent if needed. All contact positions are approximate: measure on the drawing.

Inserts (37.64, 69.08, 117.68, 130.86) are separate close drawings of the same ebonyHorse function at s 4 to 4.5 with handInsert, cut in and out; they are the only close-ups in the film (no face close-ups). Everything else stays wide or medium with full sets, per the owner direction.
The plant at 63.68 must read: both arrows (up at the knob, down at the ear) visible in one frame while Firuz looks at the stirrup. The thought cloud at 111.18 replays exactly that pose.

Speech: S.label(ctx, text, x, y, p, {balloon: true, to: [headX, headY]}) in the sky band, never over a face; long lines on two rows. Labels and bubbles at least 28 px at 1280 x 720 scale. 20 lettering items in total.
S.emphasis with {rect: panel} only at 71.65. S.transition with {rect: panel, caption: 'HOURS LATER...'} from 107.9, plate swap at its covered midpoint (about 108.25).

Sound, 8 effects, master 0.6, each under 0.5 s and inside a listed pause: chime 17.3, blip 35.6, blip 55.3, riser 71.2 (0.4 s, ends before 71.65), whoosh 89.7, glitch 108.2, chime 122.4, chime 134.0; tape bed under everything.
DUR = 138.15 (134.15 + 4.0 end hold). Subtitle chunks are those of chunks_ar.txt and chunks_en.txt, already timed in timing.json.
Run the alive checklist on contact sheets of the push-in walk (5.0 to 14.3), the demo flight (40.7 to 47.0), the vault (66.6 to 67.4), and the sky scenes (nothing frozen: cape, clouds, bob, breath).
warnings: The Library person is front-facing; a seated rider reaching forward to the horse's ear is at the limit of the arm. Test the reach at 114 to 117 and 129.8 to 131.4 early; the inserts carry the beat if the medium shot cannot.
The horse must not read as the Library black horse: keep the straight carousel legs, block mane, brass discs and the pupil-less brass eye, and never animate the legs.
Zoom 0.62 needs the tall sky plate (to y -820); without it the camera clamp will stop at zoom 1.
Sunset must stay multi-coloured (blue-violet above, coral and gold below) with the cast in their own colours; a rim light only, no tint.
The narration has only seven short pauses (0.8 to 1.2 s), so effects are few; the launch at 71.65 is silent apart from the riser before it.

Episodes 2 to 5 depend on ebonyHorse, skyFlight, flyRig and the colours fixed here; keep them in story files named for sharing (horse_kit.js, horse_sets.js, horse_cast.js) so later episodes copy them unchanged.
